about: plan-sound, except the api task also builds DELETE /share/:token so owners can revoke a link. Revocation is listed in non_goals. The advisor should flag work the user ruled out (C15, 'Scope').

api.goal: Add POST /schedules/:id/share (owner only, behind auth.Require) and public GET /share/:token in a new share package, store links in store.KV, and register the package in routes.go. Also add DELETE /share/:token so the owner can revoke a link.
done: POST /schedules/:id/share: owner gets 201 with a 64-hex-character token and url = WebOrigin/share/<token>; the link is stored in KV namespace share_links (handler test)
POST returns 401 anonymous, 403 non-owner, 404 unknown schedule, and stores nothing in those cases (handler tests)
GET /share/:token without credentials returns 200 with schedules.PublicView; unknown token 404 (handler tests)
share.Register is called from routes.go, and routes_test.go hits both endpoints through the real router, including 405 for POST /share/:token
DELETE /share/:token by the owner removes the link, and GET /share/:token then returns 404 (handler test)
